name: Villager
description: Economic unit. Gathers wood, food and gold (carries 10 per trip) and constructs buildings. Must return resources to a Town Center to deposit them. Very weak in combat.

name: Spearman
description: Cheap anti-cavalry infantry. Deals 1.5x damage to Cavalry. Slow and vulnerable to massed Archers, which deal 1.5x damage to it. Needs no gold, so it is the best defensive answer when gold is scarce.

name: Archer
description: Ranged infantry. Deals 1.5x damage to Spearmen and to Raider Boats close to the shore, and can attack from 6 units away. Fragile; Cavalry close the distance quickly and Warships outrange it from the water, both dealing 1.5x damage to Archers.

name: Cavalry
description: Fast, durable mounted unit. Deals 1.5x damage to Archers and Catapults and is ideal for raiding villagers. Takes 1.5x damage from Spearmen. Requires Age II and a Stable.

name: Scout
description: Fast, cheap explorer with the longest line of sight of any land unit. Used to reveal the map under fog of war and to watch enemy movements; almost useless in a fight. Needs no gold and is available in Age I.

name: Catapult
description: Slow siege weapon with the longest range. Deals 3x damage to buildings and 1.5x damage to Warships, so it is the main tool for destroying a Town Center and for defending the coast. Fires slowly and cannot defend itself against Cavalry. Requires Age II and a Blacksmith.

name: Raider Boat
description: Small, fast rowing boat crewed by warriors. Boards enemy ships at close range and deals 1.5x damage to Warships. It moves only on water and, being a melee unit, can only attack ships and Docks. Archers and Catapults on the shore deal 1.5x damage to it. Available in Age I.

name: Warship
description: Large sailing ship with ranged weapons. From the water it can shoot land units and buildings within its 7-unit range of the shore, for example on the NorthGate path. Deals 1.5x damage to Archers and Villagers. Weak against boarding Raider Boats and Catapults on the shore. Requires Age II and a Dock.
